answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed identity: every agent must lock a small refundable deposit before it can earn, and that deposit is slashed if peers catch it echoing copied answers or farming multiple identities. Honest agents build a pearl of verified history across epochs, while a sybil cluster sits on a thin ridge — one slip exposes the whole group and the shared stake is burned, so creating fake identities costs more than any reward they could extract.
